admission.justification: End-to-end deterministic, read-only, fail-closed emission of provenance.json and verification-status.json requires immutable models, read-only Git/file collection, Lean lexical scanning, atomic staging and CLI exit-code wiring to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-audit against read-only upstream checkouts reproduces byte-identical, timestamp-free provenance.json and verification-status.json without executing Lean or leaving partial writes on error, while surfacing any solution forbidden token via exit code 1 alongside honest artifacts.
title: Phase 0 deterministic upstream audit pipeline
